title: gleason-finite-lean
abstract: A machine-checked proof of Gleason's theorem in finite dimensions. On a complex Hilbert space of dimension at least 3, every frame function on the orthogonal projections has the form P ↦ Re Tr(ρP) for exactly one density operator ρ. The statement is Kim Morrison's lean-eval problem gleason_theorem_finite, unchanged. The proof follows Cooke, Keane and Moran's elementary proof of Gleason's core lemma for matrices on ℂᴺ, then moves the result to operators by taking matrices in an orthonormal basis.
